title: Local relative homotopy lifts from isomorphisms on homotopy sheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], equipped with a Grothendieck topology $J$ given by covering sieves. A sieve on $V$ is a collection of arrows into $V$ closed under precomposition; the maximal sieve covers, and covering sieves satisfy pullback stability and transitivity. Use simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and associated sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Write $\Delta^n=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta(-,[n])$ and let $\partial\Delta^n$ be its union of proper faces, empty for $n=0$. A Kan complex has fillers for every horn, where a horn $\Lambda_i^q$ is the union of all faces except the $i$th, $q\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq q$. Let $F,G:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$ have Kan values and let $f:F\to G$ be a natural transformation. Let $\pi_0F$ denote the presheaf of components. For $V\in\mathcal C$, a vertex $x\in F(V)_0$ and $m\geq1$, write $\pi_m(F,x)$ for the presheaf on $\mathcal C/V$ sending $u:W\to V$ to the based simplicial homotopy group $\pi_m(F(W),u^*x)$, and similarly for $G,f(x)$; the slice has the induced covering-sieve topology. Suppose $\pi_0F\to\pi_0G$ and all these maps $\pi_m(F,x)\to\pi_m(G,f(x))$ induce isomorphisms on associated sheaves. Then, for every $V\in\mathcal C$, $n\geq0$ and maps $a:\partial\Delta^n\to F(V)$ and $b:\Delta^n\to G(V)$ with $f_Va=b|_{\partial\Delta^n}$, there is a covering sieve $S$ on $V$ such that for every $u:W\to V$ in $S$ there are simplicial maps
$$c_u:\Delta^n\to F(W),\qquad H_u:\Delta^n\times\Delta^1\to G(W)$$
satisfying
$$c_u|_{\partial\Delta^n}=u^*a,\qquad H_u(-,0)=f_Wc_u,\qquad H_u(-,1)=u^*b,\qquad H_u|_{\partial\Delta^n\times\Delta^1}=(f_Wu^*a)\operatorname{pr}_1.$$
No local fibration hypothesis on $f$ is assumed, and the choices for different $u$ need not agree.

source.place: Dugger--Isaksen, Weak equivalences of simplicial presheaves, Definition 3.1, Definition 6.11 and Theorem 6.15(a), printed pp. 4, 13-14; homotopy-sheaf formulation Proposition 6.9. Also DHI arXiv:math/0205027v2 Proposition 3.1, printed p. 7. Objectwise Kan specialization of the locally fibrant theorem, forward direction. Read online 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this simplicial-presheaf homotopy-lifting theorem.
